items.prompt: Members are kindly asked to wipe down all equipment ___ use.

explanation.en: After is a preposition and takes a noun (after use). Afterwards and later are adverbs and stand alone.

items.prompt: If you have an injury, please speak to a trainer before ___ any of the weights.

explanation.en: After a preposition such as before we use the -ing form.
explanation.es: Tras una preposición («before») se usa -ing, no el infinitivo.

items.prompt: You are not ___ to bring guests into the changing rooms.

explanation.en: Be allowed to means to have permission. Let is not used in the passive, and made to means forced to.

items.prompt: To book a class, simply ___ up at reception or on our app.

explanation.en: Sign up means to register for something.

items.prompt: The pool will be closed for maintenance next week, ___ means that the sauna will also be unavailable.

explanation.en: Which refers back to the whole previous clause. After a comma we cannot use that, and what does not introduce a relative clause.
explanation.es: Después de coma se usa «which», nunca «that».
